implementation_constraints: Single file source/impl.py runnable as python impl.py
Reads all stdin and writes only stdout
Always exits 0; malformed batch input prints exactly ERROR

unresolved_intent.decision: Request objects may contain extra fields beyond method, path, and optional body.
unresolved_intent.rationale: The canonical shape names required fields but does not explicitly forbid extra metadata; ignoring it preserves batch processing without inventing new validation errors.

unresolved_intent.decision: HTTP methods are matched case-sensitively against the uppercase method names in the route table.
unresolved_intent.rationale: The spec presents method tokens as exact strings and does not define method normalization.

unresolved_intent.decision: Paths are matched literally; trailing slashes, query strings, and fragments are not normalized or parsed.
unresolved_intent.rationale: The package says query strings are out of scope and defines concrete path forms, so literal matching is the least surprising transport-free behavior.

unresolved_intent.decision: POST and PUT bodies may include fields besides name; only the presence of a string name is required.
unresolved_intent.rationale: The error rule only rejects missing, non-object, or no string name bodies, and the resource itself only stores id and name.
